## Description

Solves institutional order execution stochastic control problems in infinite-dimensional function spaces within a Wasserstein distributionally robust ambiguity set of market impact curves.

## Where it may fit

Large institutional block trades, illiquid asset liquidation under severe market impact model misspecification.

## Vehicles

Agency Execution Desks, Algorithmic Execution Brokers, Institutional Asset Managers.

## Required data

Order book depth profiles, historical volume participation curves, temporary/permanent impact coefficients.

## Caveats

Combines functional neural operator discretization with robust conic optimization solvers.
